description: Fixtures for the xebench benchmarks contract 1.2 (data/benchmarks.schema.json, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md): build.runtimes, engineVersion and bindingVersion, and the row configuration fields configurationId and configurationSha256. Each file is a complete envelope. producerMustNotEmit=true marks a file that breaks a producer rule: scripts/validate_data.mjs refuses it, so xebench never publishes it. consumerExpectation is what the website does with the file: consumers degrade per entry and fall back to the whole file only for an unknown major version, malformed JSON or no valid rows, none of which these files are. tests/test_contract_1_2.py checks producerMustNotEmit against scripts/validate_data.mjs.
